description: Delete your own 24-hour thread watch and its stored previews. This is the only tool that deletes anything. Supply slug, the watch_id from watch_thread and the saved watch_token. It cannot touch anyone else's watch: a wrong token returns an error. A read already in progress may finish. Stopping early is safe and nothing else changes.

slug.description: The board slug the watch was made for.

watch_token.description: The secret token returned when the watch was created.

name: stop_thread_watch

stopped.description: True after the watch and stored previews are deleted.

title: Stop a thread watch
